sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Combining bite-sized gamification with a 'free-forever' core model and an iconic, persistent mascot to drive industry-leading user retention.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Duolingo is the world's most popular language-learning platform, offering bite-sized lessons that utilize gamification to build reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Beyond language instruction, the company provides standardized English proficiency testing and early childhood literacy tools through its platform.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Language learning app
Duolingo English Test
Duolingo ABC
Duolingo for Schools.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Freemium (Free core product with 'Super Duolingo' subscription)

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Global consumers (all ages), K-12 students, international university applicants.
